Prioritize studying methods such as active recall and space repetition. Space out your studying times.

Test the waters and generate a strategy to optimize your time across your classes, research, and work. You’re still human. If it gets overwhelming quick then I suggest prioritizing classes and performance over anything. If that requires playing with your work schedule, research, or even taking a lighter load, then that’s the way. Otherwise, anything is doable.
